summary: Internal utilities for building file contexts, planning updates and merges, rendering docstrings, and validating update plans.
responsibilities: Build file and declaration contexts for docstring updates.
Build and override docstring update plans with retry support.
Create merge plans for docstring updates.
Render docstring lines, tags, and strings.
Validate docstring update plans and signatures.
design_decisions: Internal helper functions and modules are encapsulated to support docstring updates.
